maria.g: Quick dump from Ember-18B int4 probe. cost cuts ~50% vs fp16 but we see consistent drops on long multi-turn summarization and 3-stage rerank chains. short doc in drive.
aj: short bullets?
maria.g: - rerank nDCG down ~6 pts
- long summaries (>2000 tokens or >8 turns) ROUGE-L down ~7-9
- single-turn and short reranks fine
- latency p95 improved ~12ms
neil: layer map?
maria.g: drift concentrated in middle layers (20-24), KV scales off with per-tensor q. per-channel asymmetric improved nDCG ~+3 pts but still below fp16.
eva: ops/product routing?
neil: recommend mixed-fleet: route short-chat + autocompiles to int4; rerank pipelines and longform -> int8/fp16. add shadowing for rerank/longform on int4 for 14d.
aj: signals?
maria.g: start simple: token_count>2048 or metadata.rerank_steps>1 -> int8. add header support `X-RW-Mode: rerank` from product.
neil: experiments during canary: per-channel KV quant, group-size sweep (32/64), and mixed-precision (middle layers int8).
ops-bot: canary scheduled: `ember18b-int4-canary` starts 2026-04-02T06:00Z, alloc 3%.
maria.g: econ: routeable 70% -> org cost -38%; conservative excl reranks/longform -> -21%. checklist: 3% canary for 72h, shadow 14d, human eval 100 rerank + 100 longform pre-canary, rollback if rerank nDCG drop>4 pts or complaints +1%.
aj: will PR routing headers and token rule. thanks team :thumbsup:
